description:
Upstream enables bracketed paste mode (`\x1b[?2004h`) on terminal start and disables it (`\x1b[?2004l`) on exit. Our Terminal does not send these sequences — bracketed paste only works if the user's terminal happens to have it enabled already.

Implement: send `\x1b[?2004h` on init, `\x1b[?2004l` on terminate.

Ref: `terminal.ts` L109-112.
title: Terminal: bracketed paste mode enable/disable
